Jak mierzyć wpływ nowych funkcji sklepu: How to measure the impact of new store features on conversion?
Skuteczność funkcji oceniaj na porównywa: Assess the effectiveness of features over comparable periods and with changes that are as isolated as possible. If you roll out a new checkout, a new product page and a new free delivery threshold at the same time, it will be hard to judge what really improved the result.
Najważniejsze wskaźniki to współczynnik: The most important metrics are the conversion rate, abandoned carts, the average cart value, product page conversion, revenue from automation and user behavior in the funnel. It's worth supplementing the numbers with session recordings and click maps.

Jak checkout, płatności i dostawa wpływa: How do the checkout, payments and delivery affect sales?
Największe straty zwykle występują na et: The biggest losses usually occur at the cart and checkout stage. The number of steps, the number of fields, the transparency of costs and the availability of payment methods all affect the decision to complete the purchase.
W Polsce szczególnie ważne są szybkie pł: In Poland, quick payments, BLIK, cards and popular delivery methods are especially important. Transparent costs and the delivery time should be visible earlier than only in the last step of the cart.
Mniej barier dla nowych klientów i szybs: Fewer barriers for new customers and a faster pass through the checkout.
Brak zaskoczenia przy dostawie zmniejsza: No surprises at the delivery step reduce abandonment at the summary.
BLIK, karty i szybkie przelewy zwiększaj: BLIK, cards and quick transfers make completing the purchase more convenient.
<1>Ważne:</1> każdą zmianę w checkoutcie: <1>Important:</1> it's worth testing every checkout change carefully. It's the place closest to the money, so improvements should be rolled out in stages and measured on data.
Jakie funkcje kart produktu pomagają pod: Which product page features help customers make a purchase decision?
Karta produktu konwertuje wtedy, gdy usu: A product page converts when it removes doubts and leads the customer to the cart. The key are photos, video, benefit descriptions, parameters, a visible price, availability, delivery, returns and reviews.
Dobra karta produktu zmniejsza liczbę py: A good product page reduces the number of questions to customer service, limits returns and helps customers decide faster. It shouldn't be overloaded, but it must address the buyer's most important concerns.
Elementy skutecznej karty produktu:: The elements of an effective product page:
zdjęcia, wideo, zbliżenia i ujęcia konte: photos, video, close-ups and contextual shots,
opis korzyści oraz parametry techniczne: a description of the benefits and technical parameters written in plain language,
widoczna dostępność, termin dostawy i wa: visible availability, the delivery time and return conditions,
sekcja opinii i ocen, najlepiej z aktual: a reviews and ratings section, ideally with recent reviews,
rekomendacje produktów powiązanych lub u: recommendations of related or complementary products,
czytelne warianty, rozmiary, kolory i ta: clear variants, sizes, colors and a size chart,
wyraźny przycisk dodania do koszyka na d: a clear add-to-cart button on desktop and mobile.
Przy projektowaniu kart produktów warto: When designing product pages, it's also worth taking care of category SEO, photos and descriptions. We write more about store UX in the article <1>online store design and the customer experience</1>.
Jak wyszukiwarka i filtrowanie produktów: How do search and product filtering affect sales?
Skuteczna wyszukiwarka skraca drogę do p: Effective search shortens the path to the product and increases conversion. Autocomplete, typo tolerance, category suggestions and relevant results help customers reach the right offer faster.
Filtry są szczególnie ważne przy większy: Filters are especially important with larger catalogs. Customers should be able to narrow down products by price, size, color, brand, availability and the most important industry parameters. Sorting by price, popularity, new arrivals and delivery time supports the purchase decision.
Podpowiada frazy, produkty i kategorie,: Suggests phrases, products and categories before the customer gets lost.
Pomaga przy literówkach i wpisywaniu fra: Helps with typos and typing phrases on a phone.
Ułatwiają wybór przy szerokiej ofercie i: Make choosing easier with a wide offer and limit the user's frustration.
Warto regularnie analizować raport zapyt: It's worth regularly analyzing the store's search query report. Empty results, recurring phrases and missing synonyms show where customers can't find products, even though the store may have them in its range.
Jak marketing automation i program lojal: How do marketing automation and a loyalty program support sales?
Automatyzacje pomagają odzyskiwać porzuc: Automation helps recover abandoned carts and increase order value without increasing the ad budget. The simplest start is an email sequence after cart abandonment, product recommendations and post-purchase communication.
Program lojalnościowy zwiększa powtarzal: A loyalty program increases repeat orders if it's simple and worthwhile for the customer. Points, reward tiers, birthday benefits, referral bonuses and reminders about expiring benefits work well.
mail porzuconego koszyka z konkretnym pr: an abandoned cart email with the specific product,
przypomnienie o oglądanym produkcie,: a reminder about a viewed product,
mail po zakupie z prośbą o opinię,: a post-purchase email asking for a review,
cross-sell po zakupie i sugestie kolejny: post-purchase cross-selling and suggestions for further products,
prosty program lojalnościowy z jasnymi z: a simple loyalty program with clear rules.
Automatyzacje warto wdrażać stopniowo, b: Automation is worth rolling out gradually, because too many messages can reduce effectiveness. First cart recovery and reviews, then personalization and retention scenarios.
Jakie błędy przy projektowaniu funkcji s: Which mistakes in designing store features reduce sales?
Najczęstsze błędy to przeładowanie wtycz: The most common mistakes are overloading the store with plugins, a complicated checkout, no popular payment methods, weak search, no delivery information and problems on mobile. Each of these elements increases friction and can lower conversion.
Nadmiar funkcji może szkodzić równie moc: Too many features can hurt as much as too few. Pop-ups, widgets, heavy scripts, pushy promotions and unnecessary fields in the cart distract the user and slow down the website.
ukryte koszty dostawy pokazywane dopiero: hidden delivery costs shown only at the end,
zbyt długa karta produktu bez jasnego CT: too long a product page without a clear CTA,
brak informacji o dostępności i terminie: no information about availability and shipping time,
filtry, które nie odpowiadają realnym kr: filters that don't match the real selection criteria,
wolne ładowanie sklepu po dodaniu zbyt w: slow store loading after too many plugins have been added,
brak pomiaru zdarzeń, koszyka, formularz: no tracking of events, the cart, forms and payments.
Lepszy efekt daje kilka dobrze zaprojekt: A few well-designed features give a better result than a large number of random add-ons that slow down the store and distract the user.
